caption:
This comma is holding up two whole sentences.

A comma alone can't join two full sentences. Use a semicolon, a period, or a comma plus and, but, or so.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Spot the Comma Splice
youtube.description: A comma splice joins two full sentences with only a comma. Here are three ways to fix it on the SAT.
